messages.content: When ich have vimMode set to true in my gemini config, was do ich submit mein prompt

When `vimMode` is enabled, you submit your prompt by switching to NORMAL mode and then pressing `Enter`.

1.  Press `Esc` to exit INSERT mode (the mode you type your prompt in).
2.  Press `Enter` to submit.

Alternatively, you can often use `Alt+Enter` (or `Option+Enter` on macOS) as a shortcut to submit directly from INSERT mode.
